IN="/d/kvit-hub-rehearsal-2/settings/jobs/20261120-161851-018.scratch/echo-ha-reports.txt"; OUT="/d/kvit-hub-rehearsal-2/settings/jobs/20261120-161851-018.scratch/echo-ha-blocks.txt"; /usr/bin/rm -f "$OUT"; /usr/bin/python3 -c "
import re
text=open(r'$IN',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
# Split by day markers
import re
days=re.split(r'==================== (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}) ====================',text)
# days[0] empty, then pairs
out=open(r'$OUT','w',encoding='utf-8')
for i in range(1,len(days),2):
    d=days[i]; body=days[i+1] if i+1<len(days) else ''
    # Find echo-ha blocks: headings containing echo-ha or Block sections that mention echo-ha in table? Simpler: find all '## Block.*' sections where body contains echo-ha relevant, plus table lines
    # Extract lines with echo-ha and surrounding block sections
    lines=body.splitlines()
    # Find block headings
    for idx,line in enumerate(lines):
        if line.startswith('## Block') and ('echo-ha' in line.lower() or 'echo-ha' in ''.join(lines[idx:idx+5]).lower() or 'counter-light' in line.lower() or 'voice' in line.lower() or 'Show' in line):
            pass
    # Simpler: extract any '## Block' section whose heading or first 10 lines mention echo-ha/Echo Show/voice pipeline etc, plus B-sections
    # We'll just extract sections whose heading contains echo-ha explicitly, plus the table row
    out.write(f'===== {d} =====\n')
    # table rows with echo-ha
    for line in lines:
        if 'echo-ha' in line:
            out.write(line+'\n')
    out.write('\n')
    # Now extract full block sections headed with echo-ha
    cur=None; buf=[]
    for line in lines:
        if line.startswith('## Block') or line.startswith('## B'):
            if buf and cur and 'echo-ha' in cur.lower():
                out.write('\n'.join(buf)+'\n\n')
            cur=line; buf=[line]
        else:
            if cur is not None:
                buf.append(line)
                if len(buf)>200:
                    # flush if too long? keep
                    pass
    if buf and cur and 'echo-ha' in cur.lower():
        out.write('\n'.join(buf)+'\n\n')
    out.write('\n')
print('done')
"; /usr/bin/wc -l "$OUT"; /usr/bin/cat "$OUT" | /usr/bin/head -n 400
